column1: # Speech level of an utterance from its cue key (R). Every row is a house-style decision written in
# spec/register.md under its spec id; cases: tests/register/levels.cases.tsv (hd8gen levelcases).
#   key       the cue key of the line, the first that holds in this order: narr (a quote inside a narration
#             line), empty (no word), set, keigo-pend, pend, keigo-casual, keigo, archaic, polite-any, stiff,
#             decl-zo, exclaim-ne, exclaim, casual, bare; auth-plain is casual from an authoritative voice (REG-14)
#   profile   yes: a line of this key takes the level of the speaker in the scene (REG-8)
#   keep      yes: when the input already has a level (0.7.x's own ending), keep it instead (REG-6)
#   unquoted  a line outside quotes is speech with this level: yes; strong: only when a sentence of it ends in a
#             strong sentence-final particle (よ, ね, ぞ …); no: it is narration (REG-1, REG-7)

column7: 「…」と言った: the line ends in narration
plain endings and sentence-final particles: 해, never -다
です/ます at the end
です/ます inside the line, plain end
いらっしゃいます → 계십니다
old speech (じゃ, ておる, ぬ): the input's level until personas
である, 諸君: the input's level until personas
見つけた！, 面白い。: an exclamation of discovery keeps -다
an authoritative voice's plain statement keeps -다 (ファンだ → 팬이다)
行くぞ！ → 간다!: a declaration with ぞ or ぜ keeps -다
寒いなぁ → 춥네: an exclamation with な on a predicate is 해체 -네
